protocol: freeze-first: prediction frozen before any reference value was opened (second blind prediction)
target: singlet-triplet (S=0 -> S=1) energy gap of the [2Fe-2S]2+ model cluster (oxidized, diferric iron-sulfur dimer; two high-spin Fe3+ sites) as reported by a peer-reviewed multireference computational study (DMRG/CASPT2/NEVPT2) - ONE single published number
why_this_is_a_new_data_point: Stage-3 (BLIND_PREDICTION_002) compared the per-unit scale against broad published scales (ranges). This second test holds the SAME stack-determined prediction to a SINGLE, specific, sharper number extracted by a mechanical pre-registered rule. Prediction value is fixed by the stack: no knob, no re-derivation, no possibility of tuning the prediction to the reference.

stack.engine: FBSC v2 (compression_specialist.py at origin/main a680d23, sha256 9ca44863...e2b92e5f)
stack.native_observable: energy_barrier_kj_mol (catalytic-barrier surrogate anchored to Haber-Bosch 500 kJ/mol; NO spin Hamiltonian, NO exchange couplings, NO [2Fe-2S] model in the physics layer)

model_outputs_measured_kj_mol.note: fresh-run 2026-10-26 on exact origin/main blobs; bit-identical to the Stage-3 frozen table; deterministic, numerical uncertainty 0

derivation.what_the_stack_computes: The only energy observable native to the physics layer is E_d (d=2..6) at the owner seed. The simulator's own docstring labels the d=4 manifold 'spin x oxidation'; d=2 is the spin-only (qubit) description. A physical [2Fe-2S]2+ singlet-triplet gap is NOT a native output (no spin Hamiltonian).
derivation.derived_quantity: manifold splitting between the spin-only (d=2) and spin x oxidation (d=4) Hilbert-space descriptions: dE_mf = E(d=2) - E(d=4), same seed, same physics layer, zero new free parameters (identical quantity to Stage-3 primary).

per_unit_step.meaning: uniformly distributing the manifold splitting over the 16 core units (interpretation step: each unit = one metal/sulfur site of the model; uniform distribution is the only no-new-parameter choice) - identical to Stage-3 primary

derivation.ordering_measured: E(d=2) > E(d=3) > E(d=4) > E(d=5) > E(d=6): including more spin/oxidation levels lowers the model's characteristic energy monotonically (measured). Any derived spin splitting is positive (excited manifold above ground); for the target cluster: singlet ground, triplet first excited (gap > 0).

predicted_value.sign: positive (singlet ground, triplet first excited for the antiferromagnetic diferric dimer)
predicted_value.tolerance_definition: numerical uncertainty = 0 (deterministic stack, MSE=0, measured). Interpretational comparison band set a priori (same rule as Stage 3): factor-2 window around the per-unit prediction [114.9, 459.4] cm-1; secondary = manifold scale 3,675.65 cm-1 with +/-50% band [1,837.8, 5,513.5] cm-1. A reference value outside BOTH bands = MISS. Inside either band = HIT (membership in both recorded).
predicted_value.verdict_rule: MISS iff reference outside both bands; HIT otherwise (primary band preferred)

conversion_constants_frozen.note: extracted reference converted exactly once; reported in original units and cm-1

reference_extraction_rule.search: peer-reviewed / preprint literature (arXiv full text and abstracts, publisher abstracts/DOIs) for the singlet-triplet gap of the diferric [2Fe-2S]2+ iron-sulfur dimer model
reference_extraction_rule.acceptable_sources: peer-reviewed multireference studies (DMRG, CASPT2, MS-CASPT2, NEVPT2, RASPT2) or high-level broken-symmetry treatments reporting an EXPLICIT numerical singlet-triplet (S=0 -> S=1) energy difference for an iron-sulfur dimer model in the 2+ (diferric) charge state
reference_extraction_rule.not_accepted: exchange coupling J alone (any convention) is NOT the target number (J -> gap conversion requires convention assumptions; Stage-3 HDE 10-600 cm-1 already covered couplings)
reference_extraction_rule.scan_order: sources scanned in search-return order; take the FIRST accepted source whose text contains an explicit numerical singlet-triplet gap value for the [2Fe-2S]2+ dimer model
reference_extraction_rule.extraction: record number, unit, exact context sentence, DOI/arXiv id; convert once with frozen constants
reference_extraction_rule.no_value_found_rule: if no accepted source yields an explicit single number after scanning the FIRST FIVE distinct sources returned, outcome = 'no suitable single-number reference found' (VOID data point, neither hit nor miss; plan explicitly accepts this as a legitimate outcome). No substitute reference is then invented.

explicitly_not_predicted: A native physical [2Fe-2S]2+ singlet-triplet gap (S=0 <-> S=1): the stack has no spin Hamiltonian, no zero-field splitting, no exchange couplings, no [2Fe-2S] model.
Any chemical accuracy claim for the E_d numbers (they are unchanged surrogate model outputs, not ab initio or experimental energetics).
Any claim that a miss would falsify Validation Track stages 1-2 (representation exactness proven separately in ERROR_BOUND_PROOF.md, independent of this chemistry-level comparison).
Any hardware claim (exact classical simulation is the honest ceiling).
